OrderSend

Sends a sample trade request to the trade server.

bool  OrderSend(
   MqlTradeRequest& request,  // what to do
   MqlTradeResult&  result 
   );

Parameters

request

[in]  The request to send.

Return Value

True when the request passes the basic check. This does not mean it was executed.

  • -1, if the sample check fails;
  • 0, if it passes.
    • a nested detail

Note

Check the result structure after every call.

  1. Send the request.
  2. Read the result.
